name: amana-whatsapp-bot
description: WhatsApp front door for Amana. Connects with Baileys and answers with the Amana backend and an AI model on Groq.

scripts.build:cloud: esbuild src/cloud.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=api/whatsapp.js --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: tsx test/handler.test.ts && tsx test/webhook.test.ts && tsx test/redis.test.ts
